Returns each `JobRecord` with two operator-visibility annotations:

  sweep flagged drift (no_process) without a coherence_restored after

actor_id.description:
Optional client-suggested id. When present, must be a ULID
(used by daemon-spawned agents that pre-mint via `gen_ulid`
and propagate via SHIP_ACTOR_ID env). When absent, the daemon
mints a fresh ULID — the canonical path. Synthesis like
`agent.{name}.{branch}` is gone; the daemon is the only id
minter.

min_body_ratio.description: Override minimums. Missing fields fall back to WCAG defaults.

tokens.description:
Token map. Keys match the names in theme.schema.json. Unknown
tokens are skipped.

path.description: Absolute path to the scaffolded artifact (directory or file).

route.description:
Route where the new feature can be opened. `None` when the
surface doesn't have a browsable route.

name.description: Kebab-case feature id. Becomes the directory or file name.

purpose.description: One-line purpose for the agent + human readers. Optional.

agent.description:
Agent override. When `None`, falls back to the pipeline's
first-step `agent`, then `"default"`.

depends_on.description: Parent job slugs this run depends on.

headless.description: When true, force the headless (ProcessExecutor) path.

model.description: Model override (e.g. "sonnet"). When `None`, step YAML decides.

provider.description:
Provider override; when `None`, each step uses whatever the
pipeline YAML declared (or falls back to claude).

slug.description:
Explicit slug (e.g. `ship-dev-01kpx…`). When `None`, the daemon
generates one from `workspace` + a random suffix.

source_spec_path.description: Operator-facing path to the spec file (for `ship jobs` display).

spec.description: Inline spec body describing what the run should do.

workspace.description:
Optional workspace name; defaults to the pipeline name. Only
used when `slug` isn't supplied.

actor.description:
Optional namespace actor (e.g. "studio") — sets envelope.actor.
Defaults to "ship". Used by Studio's event emitter so subscribers
can route on namespace.

actor_id.description:
Optional actor attribution. When set, the envelope's actor_id is bound
to this value (cannot be overridden by the payload).

elevated.description: Optional elevation flag — only honoured when the auth context permits.

validate_domain.description:
When true, enforce the agent-domain rules: event_type must contain a
dot and must not start with a reserved platform namespace. Used by
MCP's `event` tool so platform namespaces stay daemon-controlled.

ErrorResponse.description:
Canonical error body returned by non-2xx responses.

Handlers today emit `{"ok": false, "error": "..."}` or
`{"ok": false, "data": "..."}`. The spec standardizes on this richer
shape so SDK consumers can branch on a machine-readable `error` code
without parsing the human-readable message.

See the [errors reference](/reference/http-api/errors/) for the full
set of codes emitted by the daemon and their remediation.

details.description:
Optional structured details. Shape varies by endpoint — see the
individual operation for specifics.

message.description: Human-readable error message. Safe to surface in UIs and logs.

data.description:
Raw bytes (UTF-8 text). Added verbatim to PTY stdin — include
`\n` for enter-key behaviour.

InstalledProvidersResponse.description:
Provider detection: which of the known providers have their CLI
binaries on PATH. Powers the command-bar's spawn card.

status.description:
One of: dispatched, gate_requested, gate_passed, gate_failed, blocked,
completed, merged, failed.

body.description:
Arbitrary JSON broadcast payload. Delivered to every agent whose
capabilities match `capability_filter` (or all agents when unset).

data.description:
Response payload; shape varies by endpoint. See individual operation
responses for concrete shapes. Represented as arbitrary JSON because
this envelope is reused across dozens of handlers that return
heterogeneous bodies (lists, single records, ack strings, error
details, etc.).

ok.description: `true` on success; `false` when the handler returned a structured error.

body.description:
Arbitrary JSON message body. Delivered verbatim to the target agent's
`mesh.send` event; schema is caller-defined.

ratio.description: `None` when either side couldn't be parsed (e.g. unsupported format).

SessionMetaWire.description:
Wire-format session meta. Mirrors `SessionMeta` but the internal
type lives in `types::private` and we want to keep that module
from leaking schemas via utoipa.

value.description:
Setting value as JSON. Shape depends on the setting (string, bool,
number, or structured object). Validated against the setting's
registered schema before persist.

outputs.description: Map of `produces.name → artifact_id` for step outputs.

manifest.description: Raw manifest file contents. `None` when no manifest exists.

manifest_filename.description:
Filename of the manifest that was found next to the template
(or in an ancestor view root). `None` when no manifest exists.

scope.description:
Scope the view was resolved from: `project` | `global`. Bundled
first-party views live in the user-global `.ship/views/` today so
surface `global` here; `bundled` is reserved for a later policy
pass (editability tiers).

template_path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the matched template.

view_name.description: Dotted view name derived from the filesystem path.

file.description:
Path relative to the view directory. Defaults to `index.html.j2`.
Must end in `.html.j2` and stay inside the view dir.

bearer_token.description: Daemon bearer token — found in ~/.ship/daemon.token after `ship daemon start`.
